Hi Alicia / Tom,

Thanks again for taking the time today — really appreciate the candid look at Acme Health's current LLM roadmap and the latency/cost constraints on your clinical summarization pipeline. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

- Recap: You run nightly batch inference for 10M records/month, average sequence length ~850 tokens. Primary concerns were tail latency during spikes and auditability for patient data.
- Value match: Redwood's Dedicated deployment + prefix KV caching can reduce per-token cost and smooth tail latency; our observability helps with compliance traces for audits.
- Next step: Technical deep dive / demo focused on your ingest -> model serving -> audit trace. We should include your CTO or VP of Engineering for exec alignment so we can unblock procurement and a pilot POC.

I attached a short one-pager and a SOC 2 summary that I mentioned on the call. Can you confirm who from Acme should join the exec alignment? If helpful, I'm happy to coordinate calendars — here are a few slots I have next week: Tue 4/28 10–11am PT, Wed 4/29 1–2pm PT, Thu 4/30 9–10am PT. Also sharing a Calendly for ease: https://calendly.com/marissa-redwood/technical-deep-dive

Action items:
- Alicia: confirm internal exec (VP/CTO) contact to include
- Acme: share any non-sensitive architecture docs you'd like us to review ahead of the deep dive
- Me: set up technical deep dive and loop in rishi (solutions engineering) and laura (sales lead) as needed
